output.summary: The evidence does not support blaming the executive director. The recurring-gift drop (-$301,200, 58% of the decline) starts at the February cutover and the vendor-configured March run. 702 of 1,140 sustainer profiles were imported without a payment method, and her arrival is only coincident. Major gifts are flat once Brandt's one-time $75,000 is excluded. Unexplained CV-BATCH deposits of $181,300 sit in suspense. They may be sustainer money, or corporate pledges and tenant fees, so the recording gap and the sustainer attrition are both unestablished. The economy and appeal-tone effects are confounded. Next: preserve and reconcile the CardVault account (do not close it), and agree who makes the donor calls. Do not terminate her on this evidence.
